desc:
⛏️ Drill Blocks for Eggs! 

⛏️ Drill insane blocks to uncover rare Animals!
💰 Collect and place Animals on your plot to earn cash!
⚡ Upgrade your drills to mine faster & go deeper!
🔥 Unlock crazy new zones, blocks, and powerful drills!

🤩 Thank you for playing! Like and favorite if you enjoy the game!
